items.name: Karan Mehta
items.title: Product Lead
items.quote: It was great working with Hardik. He is a goal oriented person and highly organized. He had worked directly under me as the Media Co-ordinator of Techfest 16-17. His perseverance is commendable and his ability to complete any task assigned to him is truly inspiring. He has the ability to develop a good rapport with his colleagues. I wish him all the luck for his future endeavours.
